teaser.en: When its pods split, this tall tree releases clouds of silky fluff, which was used to stuff mattresses and pillows.
teaser.sw: Maganda yake yanapopasuka, mti huu mrefu hutoa mawingu ya pamba laini kama hariri, iliyotumika kujaza magodoro na mito.
teaser.dg: Makakayage gachiahuka, muhi hinyu mure unatuluza sufi nyinji laini dza maingu, iriyokala ichihumirwa kuodzaza magodoro na mito.

summary.en: *Msufi* is the kapok or silk-cotton tree, a tall, buttressed tree found in villages. Its pods hold silky fibre used to stuff mattresses and pillows.
summary.sw: *Msufi* ni mti mrefu wenye mizizi-ukuta kwenye shina, unaopatikana vijijini. Maganda yake yana nyuzi laini kama hariri zinazotumika kujaza magodoro na mito.
summary.dg: *Msufi* ni muhi wa sufi, muhi mure wenye ngamba, unaophahikana vidzidzini. Makakayage gana sufi laini inayohumirwa kuodzaza magodoro na mito.

about.en:
*Msufi* is a tall tree with a straight trunk, broad buttresses at the base and branches that spread out in near-horizontal tiers. Young trunks are often studded with thorns. The leaves are divided like an open hand into several leaflets.

The pods are long and pointed. When they ripen and split, they release a mass of light, silky fibre wrapped around the seeds.
about.sw:
*Msufi* ni mti mrefu wenye shina lililonyooka, mizizi-ukuta mipana chini yake, na matawi yanayotanda kwa ngazi zinazokaribia kuwa mlalo. Mashina machanga mara nyingi yamejaa miiba. Majani yamegawanyika kama kiganja kilichofunguliwa kuwa vijani kadhaa.

Maganda yake ni marefu na yenye ncha. Yanapoiva na kupasuka, hutoa wingi wa nyuzi nyepesi laini kama hariri zilizozunguka mbegu.
about.dg:
*Msufi* ni muhi mure wenye kolo rinaroima chocho, na photsi una ngamba kulu. Magongoge ganaenea kpwa tabaka, karibu sawa-sawa na photsi. Makolo ga mihi mitsanga mara nyinji gana miya. Makodzage ni dza mkpwono uriovugulwa: chila rimwenga rina makodza madide kadhaa.

Makakayage ni mare na gana ntsa. Gachiivwa na kuahuka, ganatuluza sufi nyinji laini na phepheya, iriyozunguluka tembe.

where.en: It grows as a village tree on the south coast.
where.sw: Hukua kama mti wa vijijini pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera dza muhi wa vidzidzini pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The silky fibre, kapok, is used to stuff mattresses and pillows.
uses.sw: Nyuzi hizo laini, sufi, hutumika kujaza magodoro na mito.
uses.dg: Sufi, iriyo laini, inahumirwa kuodzaza magodoro na mito.

names.en: The Digo name is *msufi*, the same as in Swahili. In English it is kapok tree or silk-cotton tree.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *msufi*, sawa na la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *kapok tree* au *silk-cotton tree*.
names.dg: Dzinare kpwa Chidigo ni *msufi*, sawa na kpwa Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *kapok tree* au *silk-cotton tree*.

reason.en: Close relative in the same family, the baobab
reason.sw: Jamaa wa karibu katika familia moja, mbuyu
reason.dg: Ndugu wa phephi wa mbari mwenga, *muuyu*

reason.en: Another plant grown for its soft seed fibre
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaopandwa kwa nyuzi laini za mbegu zake
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaophandwa kpwa sababu ya sufi laini ya tembeze

reason.en: Wild cotton, another fibre plant of the mallow family
reason.sw: Pamba-mwitu, mmea mwingine wa nyuzi wa familia ya bamia na mlenda (*mallow*)
reason.dg: Pamba ya weruni, mmea wanjina wa sufi wa mbari ya *mallow*

definition.en: The woolly fruit of kapok trees, both the planted kapok and the wild msufi mwitu. Probably borrowed from Arabic through Swahili.
definition.sw: Tunda lenye nyuzi kama sufu la misufi, ya kupandwa na ile ya porini, msufi mwitu. Huenda lilikopwa kutoka Kiarabu kupitia Kiswahili.
definition.dg: Tunda renye sufi ra mihi ya msufi, ya kuphandwa na ya weruni (*msufi mwitu*). Anji phahi neno hiri rikakopwa kula Chiarabu kpwa njira ya Chiswahili.
